quote: For real-world long-context tasks, we evaluate AdaGroPE on the LongBench benchmark and four closed-ended tasks from L-Eval

We evaluate our method's effectiveness across various long-context benchmarks and LLMs. Results show that AdaGroPE achieves state-of-the-art performance, even surpassing models with inherent long-context capabilities on certain tasks.
